name: @picteus/specification-factory
description: TypeSpec specifications and multi-language code generation factory for Picteus.

scripts.run:viewkit: tsp compile src/viewkit/index.tsp --emit @typespec/json-schema --emit @picteus/specification-factory && node scripts/fixSchema.ts dist/viewkit/schema/viewkit.json
scripts.deploy:viewkit: shx mkdir -p ../core/src/generated ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated ../../front-end/src/generated ../../docs/static/jsonschema && shx cp dist/viewkit/typescript/viewKit.ts ../core/src/generated && shx cp dist/viewkit/typescript/viewKit.ts ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated && shx cp dist/viewkit/python/view_kit.py ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated && shx cp dist/viewkit/react/ViewKit.tsx ../../front-end/src/generated && shx cp dist/viewkit/schema/viewkit.json ../../docs/static/jsonschema/viewkit-v2.schema.json
scripts.deploy:intents: shx mkdir -p ../core/src/generated ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated ../../back-end/src/generated && shx cp dist/intents/typescript/frontEndIntents.ts ../core/src/generated && shx cp dist/intents/typescript/frontEndIntents.ts ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated && shx cp dist/intents/typescript/backEndIntents.ts ../../extensions/sdk/typescript/src/generated && shx cp dist/intents/typescript/backEndIntents.ts ../../back-end/src/generated && shx cp dist/intents/python/front_end_intents.py ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated && shx cp dist/intents/python/back_end_intents.py ../../extensions/sdk/python/picteus_extension_sdk/generated
scripts.build:viewkit: npm run build:emitter && npm run run:viewkit && npm run deploy:viewkit
scripts.build:intents: npm run build:emitter && npm run run:intents && npm run deploy:intents
scripts.build: npm run build:emitter && npm run run:viewkit && npm run deploy:viewkit && npm run run:intents && npm run deploy:intents
scripts.check: npm run check:viewkit && npm run check:intents
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
